desc: Derive the exact matching condition for fragments `A`, `B`, and `C`, including empty fragments and `p == "**"`.
Implement an efficient KMP occurrence finder for each nonempty fragment in `s`.
Chain fragment occurrences so that `A` ends no later than `B` starts and `B` ends no later than `C` starts, minimizing the final substring length.
Handle empty fragments, adjacent fragments, leading/trailing stars, fragments longer than `s`, and no-match cases.
Produce the final `Solution.shortestMatchingSubstring` implementation and verify its complexity.
